{"path": "bme.py", "content": "from board import *
import adafruit_bmp3xx as bmp3xx
i2c = I2C(scl, sda)
# Register 0xD0 reads 0x50 -> this is a BMP3XX pressure sensor (no humidity).
sensor = bmp3xx.BMP3XX_I2C(i2c, address=0x76)
print(sensor.temperature, sensor.pressure)

text: Fixed: the chip ID register reads 0x50, which identifies a BMP3XX pressure sensor (not the BME280-class part the code assumed). That device has no humidity channel. Switched to the adafruit_bmp3xx driver.
